messages:
maria: dropped a quick prototype + staging preview. two things to decide for playground streaming: 1) primary streaming control - 'Pause generation' (resume) or 'Stop generation' (final)? 2) where to show token usage - inline under the streaming message or the global header? figma: https://figma.com/proto/playground-streaming :eyes: devin: my take: make the primary control inline by the message. 'Pause generation' is less scary and fits resumable UX. if we pick Pause, include clear microcopy that explains what happens when you close the app while paused. also add aria-pressed for toggle state. sam: inline counter under the last message wins for context. header is too far. privacy note: collapse exact counts by default and reveal on hover/focus (show "~42"). tooltip: \"Estimated tokens used (prompt + output)\". elaine: accessibility basics: use aria-live=\"polite\" on the stream container and set aria-busy while streaming. announce state changes with an offscreen status element (\"Generation paused\", \"Generation resumed\"). keyboard focus must move to Resume action after pausing. nate: UX edge-case: users expect Pause to save partial generation sometimes. we should show a subtle paused banner with: \"Paused 14 resume to continue generation\" and a CTA to 'Resume' or 'Stop and discard'. for regenerate, overlay the message with a small modal/overlay that says \"Regenerating\" + spinner rather than creating a new message node. also debounce regenerate (300ms). maria: proposal: primary = Pause (inline), Stop as an overflow action for hard cancel. token counter inline, collapsed by default. show keyboard hint in tooltip: \"Pause generation (Esc)\". we'll A/B test microcopy. devin: aria snippet for prototype: ```html
``` remember to flip aria-busy to false when stream finishes and expose an offscreen status node for announcements. sam: small copy tweak: token tooltip should read exactly: \"Estimated tokens used (prompt + output)\". control tooltip: \"Pause generation (keyboard: Esc)\". token control should be focusable (tabindex=0) so keyboard users can reveal details. elaine: keyboard map suggestion: Esc toggles pause/resume when focus is in the chat; when paused, focus moves to the paused message actions. `/` focuses the prompt composer. ensure visible focus ring and >3:1 contrast on icons. ux-bot: accessibility checklist: \u2705 aria-live implemented, \u2705 aria-busy toggled, \u26A0 focus rules pending, \u26A0 keyboard shortcuts pending in docs, \u2705 tooltips tied to aria-describedby. preview-bot: staging preview: https://playground.staging.redwood/preview/stream-control-184 (expires in 72h) maria: action items: @devin wire aria-live/aria-busy + offscreen announcements in the prototype; @sam implement inline collapsed counter with hover/focus reveal; @elaine add keyboard bindings and focus movement rules to the a11y doc; @nate write the paused banner copy and the regenerate overlay copy. I'll upload two figma variants (Pause-primary vs Stop-primary + counter collapsed/expanded) and run a 6-person quick test. thanks! :thumbsup:
